collection.title: VW Sharan 2002 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Sharan 2002 to 2010 model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Sharan, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
